mapper.sql: id, auth_type, username, phone, mac, ip, nas_ip, ssid, nas_name, result, message, create_time

where.if: AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{username},'%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{username},'%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS fail FROM sys_auth_log
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ssid,''), '(有线/未知)') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM sys_auth_log
GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT auth_type AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS fail, COUNT(1) AS value FROM sys_auth_log
GROUP BY auth_type ORDER BY value DESC
